## Description

Please provide a summary of the changes and their intended impact on the platform.

---

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking defect resolution)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking capability addition)
- [ ] Security enhancement / RLS hardening
- [ ] Performance optimization
- [ ] Documentation update

---

## Security and Quality Checklist

- [ ] Zero secrets, private API keys, or Supabase service role keys committed.
- [ ] Row-Level Security (RLS) policies tested and verified for multi-client isolation.
- [ ] DOM manipulations safely use `textContent` or sanitized elements to prevent XSS.
- [ ] CORS policies and input validation preserved in `worker.js`.
- [ ] Verified across modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge).
